observations: Art: Inspected all 44 final Art captures on eight labelled sheets, plus original-resolution Civic views 3, 4, 8 and 9 and Urus views 3, 4 and 7. The Civic principal A-pillar is straight and now meets the side-window frame cleanly. Its bonnet has restrained converging creases, a crown and wrapped leading corners; the rear deck is crowned with a formed plate recess and curved end plan.

Art: The Urus bonnet shows stronger ridges and swept leading corners, with carbon and open vents retained. The hatch has a clearer diagonal fold and plate pocket without the broad inflated-looking recess of the rejected first candidate. Both additional rear views now frame the actual closure, and both whole-car overhead views fit the complete car.

Art: The other four bodies retain their prior geometry and remain intact across all six original directions; transparent cabin centres, lights and tires remain visible. The models still simplify fine fascia curvature, interior and trim. Some fine surface waviness and triangular highlights remain under close reflected light. This is a contour improvement, not OEM CAD or production racing-game fidelity.
